selection.selection_rule: Exact user-endorsed asset, appearance, native retention, semantics, additions, display gates, structure, physics, recency; unknown is not passed.
selection.scope: Best available display evidence among saved candidates; not a guarantee of physical or perceptual optimality.

native_policy.reason: A translating front alone would expose no connected storage member. Add only a shallow approximate tray attached to that front; all source faces, UVs and PBR remain unchanged.

repairs.name: drawer_connected_tray

repairs.reason: Input horizontal pull and shallow lower-right front support drawer hypothesis. Native side/perspective reveal no usable moving inner tray. Add a connected shallow tray behind the native front for visible continuity during extension; estimated construction, not observed hardware.

selection.selector: All stable native faces not assigned to the nine front assemblies below; includes rear, side walls, partition, recess backs and shelves, top, feet and any generation artifacts. Exactly one owner per source face.

interactions.name: drawer_control
interactions.action: Preview pull/push control 0 to 0.30 m outward and back; native front, handle and approved tray share one rigid owner.
interactions.expected: Whole drawer assembly translates in -Y; stationary recess floor stays on carcass. Hidden rails are approximate; no physical pass.

review_requirements: During export, account for every native face exactly once, preserving geometry, UVs and PBR. Inspect the nine front partitions for complete relief and attached pulls, with shelves, recess backs and side supports retained on carcass. Use only the proposed bounded seam adjustment; record the separate drawer tray addition within its 0.045 area budget.

Using static preview transforms only, inspect each door separately at 0, pi/4 and pi/2 radians. Its visible front and pull must move together about the selected side edge, with hinge-edge continuity and stationary neighboring fronts and carcass. Confirm child-local pivots and supported visual-root offset mapping. These are construction binding inspections, not physical endpoint tests or simulated successes.

Using static preview transforms only, inspect drawer translation at 0, 0.15 and 0.30 m toward native -Y. The native front, horizontal pull and bounded added tray must retain their relative attachment; the tray must remain partly within the cabinet at full extension and the recess base must stay fixed. Record exposed native geometry gaps without requiring detailed interiors.

Save the GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF and interactive metadata with eight independent limited opening controls and one drawer slide. Preserve declared ranges and parameter provenance. Publish immediately after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Do not run simulation, contact/load/physical endpoint tests, physical trajectories or physical acceptance loops, and do not fabricate reports.
